run_worker_loop: run the worker loop to continuously pull and process jobs from the queue until an uncaught exception occurs
process_next_job: process the next job from the queue by starting it, running the job runner, and finishing with result tracking
check_worker_resources: check if the worker has sufficient memory and CPU resources to accept a new job
save_worker_state: save the current worker state including job info and timestamp to a file using a file lock
create_loop_instance: create a Loop instance with a job runner factory, app config, and state file path to manage worker job processing
